description: Retain durable invocation facts and expose typed historical analytics with non-blocking event-capture observability

requirements.description: Persist versioned invocation facts at run completion, aggregate them through one typed and provenance-stamped measure path, and reconcile declared receipt capture without delaying run execution
requirements.title: Durable Invocation Analytics and Event Capture

validation.notes: Versioned invocation facts, explicit-unknown dimensions, projection provenance and conservation; passes 2026-10-29.
Measure registry and typed RPC share one computation; sibling TestRegistryAndTypedRPCShare* cases cover status, trend, errors and external tools; passes 2026-10-29.
Replay determinism over retained and pruned runs; passes 2026-10-29.
Receipt capture declaration reconciliation and non-blocking degradation states.

Projection at run completion is not yet durable: it runs in a fire-and-forget goroutine and Reconciler terminal writes skip it (92 of 97 recent runs had no row, EVIDENCE E-5). Usage Intelligence W1 replaces it with a durable needs-projection mark and an idempotent sweep (DEBT D-4). Planned location; W1 updates the ref when the test lands.

title: Durable Run Analytics
